threads.decision: Keep in progress until the active AMB run finishes, aggregate its outputs, and decide whether to PR the amb-adapter worktree.
threads.hypothesis: AutoMem can be evaluated against external AMB datasets by adapting benchmark memory and recall calls into the server's native API.
threads.notes: The active omb job runs from ../agent-memory-benchmark and writes to that repo's outputs directory; copy or summarize final AMB outputs here only after review.
threads.result: Adapter work exists with multiple LoCoMo, LongMemEval, PersonaMem, and BEAM runs, but the current long stability run is still active and no PR has been opened.
threads.title: Agent Memory Benchmark adapter and submission

threads.decision: Adopted as infrastructure; no active worktree remains.
threads.hypothesis: A matrix runner with isolated stacks can compare many endpoints, rulesets, and scenarios without cross-run contamination.
threads.notes: Worktree reconciliation should report this branch as merged/cleanup-only if it appears again.
threads.result: PR #19 merged the parallel matrix harness and supporting stack helpers.
threads.title: Parallel matrix harness for AutoMem config sweeps

threads.decision: Park promotion decisions until the active judged/AMB runs complete and the branch lands.
threads.hypothesis: AutoMem should be measured with BEAM's judged answer task, not only proxy retrieval metrics, to make leaderboard-comparable claims.
threads.notes: This experiment is referenced before it lands on main; the first real index from main should be rerun after the branch merges.
threads.result: A native judged harness exists on the beam-judged branch with 100K results and an active longer stability run pending.
threads.title: Native judged BEAM harness

threads.decision: Use as a cheap preflight, not as the final benchmark claim.
threads.hypothesis: A deterministic retrieval-only BEAM proxy can provide a cheap signal before running expensive judged BEAM.
threads.notes: Retrieval proxy metrics should not be described as official BEAM scores.
threads.result: PR #12 merged the retrieval proxy harness and documented the 100K proxy run.
threads.title: BEAM retrieval proxy harness

threads.decision: Superseded by EXP-BEAM-RETRIEVAL and EXP-BEAM-JUDGED; keep artifacts for historical comparison.
threads.hypothesis: The upstream BEAM runner can be pointed at AutoMem through a mem0-compatible shim.
threads.notes: Use for historical failure analysis only.
threads.result: The shim established a baseline and revealed failure modes, but was replaced for ongoing work by retrieval proxy and native judged harnesses.
threads.title: BEAM mem0-shim harness

threads.decision: Adopt bare_tag_1m_v2 as the recommended local default; treat server-side expand_relations under tag gating as ineffective.
threads.hypothesis: Isolating recall knobs across the same scenarios can attribute quality changes to specific parameters.
threads.notes: compare_rulesets.py is still markdown-only; adding a JSON sidecar remains a later enhancement.
threads.result: The v2 default ruleset improved recall by combining wider time windows, higher limits, auto decomposition, and project tag gating.
threads.title: Ruleset knob isolation and v2 defaults

threads.decision: Adopt staged cleanup workflow for raw corpus pruning.
threads.hypothesis: Noisy memory clusters can be identified and staged for deletion without damaging preserved recall scenarios.
threads.notes: Preserve vs cleanup groups are useful vocabulary for later dashboards.
threads.result: Stage-1 cleanup harness and reports were produced and PR #3 merged.
threads.title: Production corpus stage-1 cleanup

threads.decision: Adopt as layer-1 regression coverage for ingestion hooks.
threads.hypothesis: Canned hook fixtures can detect capture-quality regressions before they reach production memory.
threads.notes: This is operational regression tooling rather than benchmark scoring.
threads.result: Hook replay, metrics, and diff tooling merged in PR #2 and follow-up hook field variants.
threads.title: Layer-1 hook replay harness

threads.decision: Use as a targeted regression harness for temporal validity.
threads.hypothesis: Recall should prefer current facts over stale superseded facts when both exist.
threads.notes: Useful status fields include current_only, expectation, and probes passed.
threads.result: Current-state fixture runner and PR #170 comparison reports were produced.
threads.title: Current-state and temporal recall probes

threads.decision: Adopt staged repair evaluation before metadata migrations.
threads.hypothesis: Canonicalizing entity tags and rejecting unsafe metadata updates can improve recall without broad overfetch.
threads.notes: Key variants include sync-only, reject-only, canonicalize-safe, and post-migration.
threads.result: Entity-repair harnesses and multiple fresh/loop runs were documented and merged in PR #8.
threads.title: Entity tag repair on real data

threads.decision: Adopt metadata A/B and vector identity checks as part of server-side recall diagnostics.
threads.hypothesis: Better metadata treatment can improve /recall behavior on real-data probes without changing vectors.
threads.notes: Endpoint comparison has structured summary.json under sweep_runs, but markdown reports are separate.
threads.result: Worktree-safe metadata A/B tooling and server-side metadata search evals merged in PR #9 and PR #10.
threads.title: Server-side metadata signal diagnosis

threads.decision: Adopt as guardrail coverage for recall regression testing.
threads.hypothesis: Negative controls can expose broad overfetch and unsafe recall wins that positive-only scenarios miss.
threads.notes: Treat negative controls as safety checks, not quality wins.
threads.result: Negative-control probes were added and documented in PR #11.
threads.title: Negative-control recall probes

threads.decision: Keep as a supplemental benchmark harness, separate from official AutoMem benchmark claims.
threads.hypothesis: WRIT-style history-aware adapter diagnostics can complement /recall scenario scoring.
threads.notes: third_party/writ may show submodule-local generated files during runs.
threads.result: WRIT integration and adapter reporting merged in PR #6.
threads.title: WRIT adapter diagnostics

threads.decision: Parked until a concrete maturation runner is prioritized.
threads.hypothesis: Recall quality may improve through maturation or consolidation processes beyond immediate ingestion.
threads.result: Design notes exist, but there is no durable runner or decision record yet.
threads.title: Memory maturation evaluation concept
